Jira commands

Usage: atlassian-cli jira [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  issue       Issue operations (search, get, create, update, delete, etc.)
  project     Manage projects
  components  Manage components
  versions    Manage versions/releases
  roles       Manage project roles
  fields      Manage custom fields
  workflows   Manage workflows
  bulk        Bulk operations
  automation  Manage automation rules
  webhooks    Manage webhooks
  audit       Audit log access
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -f, --format <FORMAT>  Output format for command results (table, json, yaml, csv, quiet, markdown)
                         [default: table] [possible values: table, json, yaml, csv, quiet, markdown]
      --envelope         Wrap JSON/YAML list output in {"data": [...], "count": N} envelope
  -h, --help             Print help
